summary: Run DaVinci Resolve in a prepared Linux container with desktop integration. Fedora Atomic, Bluefin, and Bazzite are the primary supported systems; other distributions receive community support.
overview: DavinciBox packages a prepared environment for Resolve so that its runtime dependencies can live inside a container while the application remains accessible from your desktop. This approach is particularly relevant to image-based Linux systems where changing the host's software environment is less convenient. It prepares the environment around Resolve; the Resolve application and its software license remain separate.
